subject: SOC 2 closure path to unblock Evergreen Bank procurement
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team - Evergreen Bank <procurement@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Evergreen SOC 2 materials + timeline ask

Hi Maya / Evergreen procurement,

Thanks for the quick response during the demo yesterday. Per our conversation Evergreen's procurement/legal team asked for our SOC 2 Type II and a bridge letter covering the gap between the most recent report and contract start. Quick context: this is to support a 1.2M ARR enterprise deal (DEAL-78921).

Request: can you confirm the absolute deadline for receiving the procurement packet? You mentioned mid-December — is 2026-12-15 the cut-off to be on the December vendor committee?

To make this as actionable as possible, attaching the procurement checklist you sent over and a filled sample for our security team.

Attachments: soc2-request-form.xlsx (filled basic fields)

We want to move fast on our side — looping in our security and leadership here to prioritize the bridge letter and evidence. Marissa: can you help coordinate legal review if we get a draft from security?

Appreciate it,

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@evergreenbank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T12:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evergreen SOC 2 materials + timeline ask

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for sending this over. Confirming the vendor committee cutoff is 2026-12-15 to be reviewed in the December cycle. For SOC evidence we need: the most recent SOC 2 Type II report, any bridge letter that covers period after the report's covered period, and a short summary listing controls for data retention, access logs, and incident response.

One note on scope: we require the bridge letter to be signed by your security leadership (CISO or equivalent) and by the auditor if possible, or at minimum reference the auditor's report issued with the Type II. We also need a contact for the security walkthrough — evergreen will run a short assurance call the week of 12/13 if the packet is delivered on time.

Attachment: Evergreen_SecurityQuestionnaire.pdf (for reference)

-Maya
Maya Patel
Senior Procurement Manager | Evergreen Bank
maya.patel@evergreenbank.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: URGENT: Evergreen procurement deadline — need SOC 2 bridge letter + evidence by 12/13

Team — quick escalation. Evergreen (prospect DEAL-78921) confirmed they need our SOC 2 report + bridge letter by 12/15 to hit their vendor committee. They will run a short assurance call the week of 12/13.

Why this matters: 1.2M ARR; procurement will punt the review if we miss the packet. We need a signed bridge letter (CISO or delegated sec lead signature) plus a small evidence bundle (controls summary, retention policy, audit log samples) by 12/13 EOD PST to allow time for legal/docuSign routing.

Ask: Rishi / Security — can you prioritize a bridge letter draft and an evidence manifest we can hand to Evergreen? If security can sign or approve to legal by EOD 12/6 PST, I can route to procurement and schedule the call.

Attachments: soc2-request-form.xlsx (the form they want populated)

If you need me to escalate to execs for temporary exception approvals or credits, say the word — but first we need the security artifact.

Thanks,
--
Soojin

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Evergreen procurement deadline — need SOC 2 bridge letter + evidence by 12/13

Soojin / team — understood and marking high priority. Quick status and plan: 

1) Audit coverage: Our last SOC 2 Type II covers the period 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30, report issued 2026-10-15 by Marlin & Co. That matches Evergreen's ask. They want a bridge letter to cover 2026-10-01 through contracting (assumed Dec 2026).

2) Bridge letter: Security can produce a bridge letter that states there have been no material control changes since 2026-09-30 and references the Marlin & Co. attestation. We'll prepare a draft and target an internal sign-off from me (acting CISO sign-off) by EOD 2026-12-06 if resources allow. If Evergreen requires an auditor-signed letter, we'll request expedited confirmation from Marlin; that may push timeline by 48-72 hours.

3) Evidence bundle: we'll assemble a concise packet with: controls summary (access controls, retention, incident response), sample audit/log extracts (redacted), and an evidence_manifest.xlsx that maps Evergreen's questionnaire rows to our artifacts. Estimated ETA for initial bundle: 2026-12-06 11:00 PST. Finalized pack (signed bridge + manifest) ETA: 2026-12-06 EOD if legal sign-off proceeds.

Action items:
- Security: Rishi to attach bridge_letter_draft.pdf + evidence_manifest.xlsx (in progress).
- Legal: Marissa to review the bridge letter for any language changes and confirm DocuSign workflow.
- Sales: Soojin to confirm the procurement cutoff (already confirmed) and schedule assurance call for week of 12/13.

I will attach the draft and manifest to this thread when ready. If anyone sees blockers (auditor signature required, regulatory phrasing) flag immediately.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team - Evergreen Bank <procurement@evergreenbank.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Evergreen procurement deadline — need SOC 2 bridge letter + evidence by 12/13

Thanks Rishi — this is perfect and exactly the level Evergreen asked for. Marissa: can you triage legal review first thing 12/6 and confirm whether the "acting CISO" sign-off is sufficient for Evergreen, or whether they insist on auditor countersignature? If legal is good with our wording, I'll route the signed PDF to procurement and send the DocuSign link for signature routing.

Proposed next steps:
- 12/06 13:00 PST: Legal confirmation on wording (Marissa)
- 12/06 15:00 PST: Rishi to upload final signed bridge_letter_draft.pdf to this thread and push evidence_manifest.xlsx
- 12/07: Schedule assurance call with Evergreen for any follow-ups (slot week of 12/13)

Evergreen procurement team — we will deliver the signed bridge letter + evidence bundle by 12/06 EOD PST for your review and to allow your committee time. Will that meet your internal deadlines?

Attachments pending from Security: bridge_letter_draft.pdf, evidence_manifest.xlsx

Appreciate the quick coordination — will update here as items land.

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
